dedupe_keys.name: ev4eu electric road mobility scenarios to 2050

description: The EV4EU project publishes historical and projected electric-road-mobility indicators through 2050. Its workbook covers vehicle technologies, sales and stock, battery and electricity demand, and public charging points. Geographic coverage includes the world, Europe, Portugal, Denmark, Greece and Slovenia. Zenodo provides the Excel workbook with text and Word documentation, publicly available and free under CC BY 4.0. These scenarios can constrain charging-infrastructure and fleet-demand simulations that connect model-sumo mobility assumptions with model-pypsa electricity planning. A caveat is that projections combine published scenarios and estimation methods, not representing observed future adoption. Users must preserve geography, technology, scenario and collection-method labels when comparing values. The README gives inconsistent units for one energy-to-distance conversion, so that calculation requires checking against the workbook. No workbook cells were independently checked.
